This '''unidentified [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]''' was a part of the [[Mandalorian secret service/Legends|Mandalorian Secret Service]] and a part of [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Almec/Legends|Almec's]] team of smugglers.

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], were called to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] to investigate a corruption case. Tano was given the task of looking into the matter, and with help from a few cadets from the [[Royal Academy of Government/Legends|Royal Academy of Government]] of Sundari, they discovered Almec's involvement in the black market conspiracy. She then brought the cadets to the Prime Minister, accusing them of the black market conspiracy and claiming that the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] of Mandalore, [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] was their leader. The cadets were later imprisoned at the [[Royal prison/Legends|Sundari prison]]. However, Almec was a bit suspicious of Tano and alerted the guards to report to him of any suspicious activities. Almec's suspicion proved right as it was all a plan to expose his activities. After Almec was informed that Tano used a [[Mind trick/Legends|Jedi mind trick]] on one of the guards to lead her to Satine's detention cell, he and a group of secret service officers arrived and captured Tano.
This sergeant was ordered by Almec to put a [[Shock collar/Legends|shock collar]] on Satine's neck to torture her and convince her to sign a confession of [[Treason/Legends|treason]] and when she refused he ordered the sergeant to bring him the cadets to persuade her otherwise. However, Ahsoka managed to break free and with the help of the cadets overpowered the officers, which were later arrested.
